content.overview: BNS s. 340 — Forged document or electronic record and using it as genuine.
content.study:
Introduction and meaning
Forged document or electronic record and using it as genuine. BNS restatement of IPC 471. Elements are substantially the same; cite the BNS number for offences on or after 1 July 2024. BNS restatement of IPC 471. Cite the BNS number for facts on or after 1 July 2024.
In student language: BNS s. 340 is the rule on “Forged document or electronic record and using it as genuine”. The section provides that (1) A false document or electronic record made wholly or in part by forgery is designated a forged document or electronic record. Do not stop at the heading. An examiner awards marks for the ingredients, the explanations and the illustrations, not for writing the title alone.

Why this is asked
Criminal law arguments turn on statutory ingredients. BNS s. 340 exists so that “Forged document or electronic record and using it as genuine” has a closed legal test in Chapter XVIII — Of Offences Relating to Documents and to Property Marks. An authoritative analysis defines the concept, lists every ingredient, walks the statutory illustrations, states exceptions, and applies the test methodically to facts.
Chapter setting: False documents, forgery, using a forged electronic record, property marks.

The provision in detail
340. (1) A false document or electronic record made wholly or in part by forgery is designated a forged document or electronic record

(2) Whoever fraudulently or dishonestly uses as genuine any document or electronic record which he knows or has reason to believe to be a forged document or electronic record, shall be punished in the same manner as if he had forged such document or electronic record

Essential ingredients
1. (1) A false document or electronic record made wholly or in part by forgery is designated a forged document or electronic record
2. (2) Whoever fraudulently or dishonestly uses as genuine any document or electronic record which he knows or has reason to believe to be a forged document or electronic record, shall be punished in the same manner as if he had forged such document or electronic record
